description: Use when someone wants a number counted that Tickerz does not publish yet, or a market needs a number nobody sells. Send counts (what should be counted, one line, 3 to 160 characters), optionally source_url (where it can be read) and ticker (2 to 12 letters or digits). Tickerz reads the source's terms, then within 48 hours either builds it as a ticker (rule, source, a script that recounts it, the first reading on record) or posts the plain reason it cannot be built, at https://tickerz.com/x. What you send is never shown publicly; the answer is in Tickerz's own words. Returns the count of numbers named so far. At most 3 a day from one address. Same as POST /api/indices/requests. Free. For an on-chain count that can go live in minutes instead, a person can type it at https://tickerz.com/launch.

counts.description: What should be counted, in one line, e.g. "new Farcaster accounts per day"

source_url.description: Optional: where the number can be read, http(s)

ticker.description: Optional: a ticker for it, 2 to 12 letters or digits, with or without the dollar sign

name: name_a_number
title: Name a number
